_scaffold_note: First general-sweep map. Player = generic HP-bar anchor (no character/template). Mobs = generic pooled model. Geometry values marked TODO_MEASURE need a live frame; sweep numbers are starting guesses to tune in-game.
_player_note: Empty {} = default red-HP-bar detection (DEFAULTS in player.py). Add hue_lo / sat_val_lo / foot_offset / bar-geometry overrides here only if the anchor misgrabs on this map.
_gather_note: z = push/gather (path-scoop) skill, 1s cooldown: dashes forward and scoops mobs along the path into a clump within attack_range, doubling as forward locomotion. grp/min/dash_gap are starting guesses: grp=how spread mobs must be to bother scooping, min=fewest mobs worth a scoop, dash_gap=attack_range - dash reach. Tune live.
_sweep_bounds_note: TODO_MEASURE: [mm_x_lo, mm_x_hi] = minimap x of the platform's left/right ends, so she turns around at an edge instead of walking off. Read via python live_pos.py while standing at each end. null = no edge turnaround (relies on empty-ground ADVANCE only).
_minimap_note: PROVISIONAL (measured from a capture frame's 小地圖 content area). Refine live if the dot reads look off. Note: this map's minimap SCROLLS (very wide), so (x,y) is view-relative.
_map_box_note: PROVISIONAL: permissive full-crop box so recording doesn't reject valid dots. Tighten after live observation.
